about: Modules this launcher knows about. One that is not installed shows as a greyed tab when its GitHub repo has a published release at or above minVersion. Set "published": true to show it anyway (for example when GitHub cannot be reached) or false to hide it. Example entry: { "id": "alpha", "name": "Alpha", "title": "Alpha module", "repo": "SomtimesOttomation/AlphaModule", "minVersion": "0.1.0", "icon": "ui/img/catalog/alpha.svg" }
